## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`npm test`, `npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, config or commands changed
- [ ] `npm run schema` run if `src/spec.ts` changed
- [ ] A line added under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Keeps the trust rules: no unverified numbers, private metrics stay private, model has no tools or secrets, nothing published without a merge, only collaborators with write access can trigger it
